messages:
From: Lauren Price <lauren.price@heliumhealth.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 17 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orderform: minimum reconciliation & bundle-to-slab mapping

Diego —

Thanks for sending the draft order form. Our procurement and finance teams reviewed Exhibit B (pricing schedule) and have two areas that need immediate clarification before we can sign:

1) Minimum commit true‑up: the redline references a "Committed Volume" and a monthly true‑up. For our bundled SKUs (annual prepay converted to monthly equivalents) can you confirm whether the Bundled SKU counts toward Committed Volume for true‑up purposes, or if those are treated separately? If they count, please show a worked example (3 months) with a 20% ramp.

2) Cap/floor interaction during ramp: the proposed floor language includes a carveout for promotional credits and trial months. Can you confirm whether the floor is applied on net billed dollars or gross token equivalent? Our legal needs explicit language so they can mark it in their redline.

We attached our questions file and a sample of the redline we received. Can you and your legal/finance counter with plain‑English examples and the exact clause text you are proposing?

Attachments: [Helium_Health_RFP_PricingQuestions.docx]

Thanks,
Lauren Price
Procurement Manager
Helium Health

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference>
To: Lauren Price <lauren.price@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 17 May 2028 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orderform: minimum reconciliation & bundle-to-slab mapping

Lauren —

Appreciate the clear asks. High level answers up front, then proposed redline language and a short numeric example below. I attached a marked PDF of Exhibit B and a pricing workbook that walks the example.

Short answers:
- Bundled SKUs: yes, treated as part of Committed Volume for true‑up, but only after conversion to the token equivalence shown in the pricing workbook. Promotional credits are excluded from Committed Volume.
- Floor calculation: computed on token equivalent (gross) and compared to billed net dollars after credits are applied for billing; the true‑up uses token equivalents to avoid currency timing differences.

Proposed language (for Exhibit B - Pricing Schedule):
"Committed Volume" means the aggregate token equivalent of all Purchased SKUs and Bundled SKUs during the Measurement Period, excluding promotional credits and trial allocations. The token equivalence table in Appendix A will be used to convert bundled SKUs to tokens for reconciliation.

"Floor Calculation" means the greater of (i) the Floor Percentage applied to the Average Monthly Token Equivalent over the trailing three (3) months, or (ii) the minimum annual guaranteed token equivalent specified on the Order Form. Floor calculations will be performed on token equivalents; invoicing will reflect net dollars after any credits.

Numeric example (attached workbook shows line by line):
- Month 1 booked tokens: 90k (bundles converted to 60k through Appendix A), Month 2 booked tokens: 120k, Month 3 booked tokens: 150k.
- Trailing 3 month average = (90k+120k+150k)/3 = 120k.  Floor = Floor% * 120k -> results in X tokens; true‑up triggers if cumulative delivered tokens < Committed Volume.

Next steps:
1) Laura (finance) — please confirm the invoice representation (token vs $) you're comfortable with in the billing stub.
2) Marissa/Karthik — if this is acceptable commercial tradeoff, I'll circulate the redline back to Helium with the updated Exhibit B PDF and the workbook.

Attachments: [Diego_proposed_ExhibitB_redline.pdf, pricing_workbook.xlsx]

Best,
Diego Fernandez
AE, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Thanks Diego —

We reviewed the proposed wording and the workbook. A few follow ups from legal and finance after reviewing the redline:

- Legal asked whether the "token equivalence table" in Appendix A can be amended by Redwood unilaterally (they want a change control lock). Please confirm you will require mutual written consent for any changes to Appendix A.
- Finance wants to confirm whether credits (promotional/introductory) that reduce invoiced dollars will reduce the denominator used for calculating the Floor; your answer above implies credits are excluded from Committed Volume but you still invoice net dollars. We need a single, unambiguous sentence tying together invoice presentation and reconciliation arithmetic.
- Finally, Helium attached their redline of Exhibit B (see attachment). They've proposed replacing a trailing‑3 month average with a rolling 6‑month average; that materially benefits them during ramp. Are you willing to move to 6 months or meet in the middle (4 months)?

If we can get explicit clause text on mutual consent for Appendix A changes and one clear sentence that states whether invoice dollars or token equivalents are authoritative for reconciliation, we can move to countersignature. Please also include a one‑paragraph example with $ numbers (not just tokens) so our CFO can sign off.

Attachments: [Helium_Redline_ExhibitB.pdf]

Best,
Lauren
Procurement Manager, Helium Health

Team — internal summary and recommended path so legal can draft final language: 

Summary of Helium asks:
- Mutual consent language for Appendix A change control.
- Clarify whether invoiced net dollars or token equivalents are the authoritative basis for true‑up arithmetic.
- Helium proposed moving trailing average to 6 months; they want more protection during ramp.

Recommendation (to be included in Exhibit B redline we send back):
1) Appendix A change control: add a 2‑sentence block: "Appendix A (Token Equivalence Table) may be amended only by written agreement signed by authorized representatives of both parties. Any proposed changes shall be provided 30 days in advance and will not be effective until the parties mutually agree in writing."

2) Authoritative metric: adopt token equivalents as the authoritative reconciliation metric; add an explicit billing mapping sentence: "For the avoidance of doubt, reconciliation and Floor/True‑Up calculations shall be performed on token equivalents; invoices will be presented in USD after application of credits, and the token equivalence table in Appendix A will be used to convert any bundled SKUs into token equivalents solely for reconciliation purposes."

3) Trailing window: propose 4‑month rolling average as a compromise between Helium's 6 and our 3. This captures ramp smoothing without locking Redwood into artificially high floors during rapid scale.

Action items: 
- Laura: confirm we can accept token equivalents as authoritative and confirm invoice stub language (I included a suggested line above).
- Marissa/Karthik: approve the commercial compromise (4‑month) so I can send the redline back to Helium tonight.
- Legal (I'll loop in after internal signoff): prepare Exhibit B with the Appendix A change control block and the authoritative metric sentence.

Attachments: [final_ied_orderform_draft.pdf]

Diego Fernandez
AE, Strategic Accounts
